data.value: The chapter sequence controls playback order. Reorder or sort the draft, then Save to keep it.

data.value: No user matches this library code. Check the code and try again.

data.value: Permanently delete “{0}” and all stored files? This cannot be restored from the filesystem.

data.value: Disconnect libraries with {0}? Access will be removed for both users.

data.value: Upload these files now? Matching normalized filenames and archives will be replaced. This cannot be undone by discarding edits.

data.name: DuplicateFiles
data.value: Choose files with distinct filenames in one upload.

data.value: Empty files cannot be uploaded. Choose files with content.

data.name: EnterNameToUpload
data.value: Enter an available audiobook name to enable upload.

data.name: FeedCopied
data.value: Feed link copied. Paste it into your podcast app.

data.name: FeedFailed
data.value: The feed link could not be prepared. Try again.

data.name: FinishPlaybackHelp
data.value: This manually closes the activity record. It does not change audiobook files or verify listening progress.

data.name: InvalidNumbers
data.value: Use a rating from 0 to 100 and a nonnegative series position.

data.name: LeaveDraftHelp
data.value: Save your changes before leaving, discard the draft, or keep editing.

data.name: LibrariesConnected
data.value: Libraries connected. Both users now have access.

data.name: LibrariesDisconnected
data.value: Libraries disconnected. Access was removed in both directions.

data.name: LoadFailed
data.value: Audiobooks could not be loaded. Try again.

data.name: MaintenanceFailed
data.value: The operation could not be queued. Try again.

data.name: MaintenancePreviewFailed
data.value: The affected books could not be loaded. Try again.

data.value: Queued an operation for {0} stored audiobooks. Processing results will appear below.

data.name: MaintenanceQueuedOne
data.value: Queued an operation for 1 stored audiobook. Processing results will appear below.

data.name: MaintenanceReviewHelp
data.value: Review the scope before running. Changes to files or metadata cannot be undone here. Jobs run in the background; watch the processing results below.

data.name: MaintenanceScope
data.value: This operation affects {0} stored audiobooks across all libraries.

data.name: MaintenanceScopeOne
data.value: This operation affects 1 stored audiobook across all libraries.

data.name: NameCheckFailed
data.value: The name could not be checked. Use a name without path characters, or try again.

data.name: OperationHelp_reprocess
data.value: Run normalization, audio conversion, metadata reading and ZIP creation on extracted files for every stored audiobook. Metadata and generated archives can change.

data.name: OperationHelp_restore
data.value: Read metadata from every stored audiobook and add or update its library record. Existing metadata can be replaced. Archives are not extracted.

data.name: OperationHelp_unzip
data.value: Extract each available ZIP first, then run the full processing pipeline for every stored audiobook. Extracted files, metadata and generated archives can be replaced.

data.name: OwnLibraryCode
data.value: This is your own code. Enter another user’s code.

data.name: PlaybackFinishFailed
data.value: Playback could not be marked finished. Try again.

data.name: PlaybackHelp
data.value: These records track feed requests and file downloads, not actual listening progress. Downloading the final chapter does not prove completion. Mark finished to remove a record from this list.

data.name: PlaybackLoadFailed
data.value: Playback activity could not be loaded. Try Refresh.

data.name: PodcastInstructions
data.value: In your podcast app, choose Add a show by URL (or Add RSS feed), then paste the feed link below. Keep this personal link private.

data.name: ProcessingCheckFailed
data.value: Processing status could not be checked. Return to the library to find the audiobook.

data.name: ProcessingHistoryHelp
data.value: Shows the latest 200 book outcomes since this app instance started. Failed jobs need administrator investigation.

data.name: ProcessingOpenEditor
data.value: The editor will open when the audiobook is ready.

data.name: ProcessingTakingLonger
data.value: Processing is taking longer than expected. Check the library or ask an admin to inspect processing status.

data.name: RatingHelp
data.value: 0 means unrated. Rated books use a score from 1 to 100.

data.name: RecentDateHelp
data.value: New imports have an added date. Older records without a date appear after them.

data.name: ReplacementHelp
data.value: New filenames add files. Matching normalized filenames replace existing files; a ZIP replaces the stored archive and extraction can overwrite matching chapters. Uploads are saved immediately and cannot be undone by discarding the metadata draft.

data.name: SaveBeforeUpload
data.value: Save your metadata changes before uploading files.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: Changes could not be saved. Your draft is still here. Try again.

data.name: SelectUploadFiles
data.value: Select one or more files. Upload starts immediately.

data.name: ShareFailed
data.value: The libraries could not be connected. Try again.

data.name: ShareLookupFailed
data.value: The code could not be checked. Try again.

data.name: SharingHelp
data.value: Connections are mutual. Both users can browse, listen to, edit and delete audiobooks in each other’s libraries. Disconnecting removes access in both directions.

data.name: UploadDraftRetained
data.value: Files were processed. Your metadata draft has been kept; reopen the audiobook after saving or discarding it to refresh the chapter list.

data.name: UploadFailed
data.value: Upload failed. Check the file and try again.

data.name: UploadHelp
data.value: Use MP3 or M4A audio files, or a ZIP containing one audiobook. Cover images and M3U playlists can be included. M4A files are converted to MP3 chapters.

data.name: UploadLimits
data.value: The app does not set a file-size limit. Your server or proxy may impose one. Keep this page open until every upload completes. Processing starts after all selected files arrive.

data.name: UploadOrder
data.value: An included M3U playlist controls chapter order when it lists all audio files. Otherwise unique embedded track numbers are used, then filename order. Use zero-padded filenames such as 01, 02, 03 and review Chapters after processing.

data.name: UploadProcessing
data.value: All files uploaded. Audiobook processing has started.

data.name: UploadProcessingFailed
data.value: Files were uploaded, but processing failed. Ask an admin to inspect the processing result.

data.name: UploadReady
data.value: Processing completed. Metadata and chapters have been refreshed.

data.name: UploadReview
data.value: Files are uploaded. Review the imported metadata and Save to keep your title and edits.
